en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The conception of disease. Resistance, predisposition, tolerance, immunity. Symptoms, habit diagnostic and aetiology of disorders - the macroscopic appearances, coloration, branching. Biological agents of diseases - virus, bacteria, fungi, vascular plants. The methodology of pest determination on amenity trees and shrubs - symptoms of disease, sign of pathogen, determination using imunofluorescency, isoenzymes, molecular biology etc. Wood decay, white rot, brown rot, blue-staining fungi. Wood decay, pathogen of vascular tissues fungi - symptoms, agents, host and control. The disease of leaves and needles: rust, blight etc. - symptoms, agents, host and control. The disease of broadleaved trees - root rot and stability of trees, rot of stems, branches and twigs, disease of leaves, vascular disease. Disease of coniferous species - the rot of roots and stems, the vascular disease. Disease of seedling and young plants, the problems of plants protection in the nurseries and public gardens. The epidemiology and quarantine pest.
